questions.question: She said she would have left earlier if she hadn’t been waiting for her flight. What is the correct way to report this statement using the past perfect in the past simple tense?
options: She said, ‘I would have left earlier if I hadn’t waited for my flight.’
She said, ‘I would leave earlier if I hadn’t waited for my flight.’
She said, ‘I left earlier if I hadn’t waited for my flight.’
She said, ‘I would have waited earlier if I hadn’t left for my flight.’
questions.answer: She said, ‘I would have left earlier if I hadn’t waited for my flight.’
